Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have for you from this exciting game of cricket! The series has already been won by West Indies but there is still one more game to go. The last game will be played on 16th July at 1930 Local (2330 GMT). So do join us for that. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Aaron Finch, the Australia skipper, says that it is really good to get a win against West Indies. Adds that Marsh got off to a flier so he took the backseat and tried to take his time. Mentions that the rain breaks were short so that didn't hamper their concentration. Adds that they bowled really well in the middle. Further adds that Starc bowled an excellent last over and he knew if he executes his plans then it will be difficult for the batter to hit him for runs.

Nicholas Pooran, the West Indies skipper, says that they didn't start properly and let the batters get away from them. About Thomas, says that he started really well but it was unfortunate that was hit for runs in the Powerplay. Adds that he is a young guy and will learn from it. About their batting, says that they needed to bat well in the middle overs and credits Starc for how he bowled. Finishes by saying that Walsh has been very impressive.

Mitchell Marsh is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says that he wanted to go on after getting to his half-ton, they have had a chat about it and they needed someone to go onto score a big one. States it is always nice to get a couple of wickets and they defended really well against a good Windies side. Adds they had enough, 190 was above par, the wicket got slower as the game went on but the Windies' side came hard and they are pleased they could defend it.

Earlier in the game, Finch and Marsh batted really well to give Australia a very strong platform. At one point, they looked like they would get over 200 but Walsh led the comeback for the hosts and restricted them to 189. In the end, it was enough as Australia won by 4 runs!

West Indies got a good start with Simmons and Lewis providing with early fireworks. But Lewis fell and that changed things. Gayle could not last long and Fletcher went back for a timid score after struggling for a while. Still, they were in control with Simmons playing a good knock in the middle. They did struggle in the middle overs as the bowlers took the pace off the ball and Zampa bowled really well. They lost Pooran and Simmons of consecutive balls which meant that they had two new batters at the crease with the required rate climbing up rapidly. Allen and Russell batted well to bring things back in their sight. Allen in particular was brilliant as he hit the penultimate over for 25 but Russell could not finish things off for his team.

Australia were under the pump in the first few overs but Zampa broke through to get them back in the game. Marsh then took the wicket of Gayle to ease things further. The bowlers bowled really well in the middle overs as they bowled quite a few slower ones and yorkers to make it difficult for the Windies' batters. Zampa finished with 2 wickets for just 20 runs in his two overs and then Marsh took another 2 wickets in the 16th over and ended his spell with just 24 runs for his 3 wickets. They had 36 to defend in the last two but Meredith leaked 25 runs in that over to tilt things back in the favor of the hosts. But Starc bowled one of the best overs in T20 cricket against Russell to get them over the line with 4 runs.
What an exciting finish it was and Australia have held their nerves to win this one. Their first win of the series and they will be pleased with this!

SIX! This one goes over the ropes but it won't matter as AUSTRALIA HAVE WON THE GAME BY 4 RUNS! This is full and on middle, Russell heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. A huge roar of joy from the Australians. Take a bow, Starc, you have defended 10 against one of the biggest hitters in the world. Pretty sure very few would have bet against Russell from getting those runs. The tall left-armer though has rose to the occasion and GIVEN THE AUSSIES THEIR FIRST WIN OF THIS TOUR!

In the air... has that gone all the way? No, it lands in the park, just ahead of deep mid-wicket and Russell still does not run which means, Australia just need to bowl a legal delivery to win the game. This is a full toss, a knee-high full toss but at a tremendous pace. Russell swings, it goes off the splice up in the air but lands ahead of deep mid-wicket. So if no extras, Australia will win it.

4 dots in a row! Now the next one has to go for a biggie or at least a boundary for Windies to stay in the game. Brilliant from Starc! From around the wicket, he is cramping Russell for room by angling it into the pads, Russell swings but misses to get hit on the pads. He is bowling with a lot of pace. Not easy to hit those.
Three dots in a row! The next one has to go to the fence! Another low full toss on the pads, Russell once again hits it to the man at deep mid-wicket.

Russell does not take the single! He wants to do it himself and rightly so. Starc though bowls this full again and on the pads, difficult to hit those over the ropes, it is heaved towards deep mid-wicket.
Nails the low full toss, on the pads. All that Andre Russell can do is push it towards long on. Dot ball as he denies the single. Excellent blowing by the experienced bowler.
Hayden Walsh walks out to bat. Who will bowl the final over? Both Starc and Behrendorff have one left. Aaron Finch has gone with Starc to defend 11 from these 6 balls.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! An anti-climatic end to the over as Allen has edged one to the keeper. 11 needed then from the final over. A superb hand by Fabian. He has surely done his job. He had to go for another one and he does try to do that. Riley bowls it full and outside off. Allen reaches out for it, it goes off the outside edge and the keeper takes it. A wicket to end but the damage was done earlier on. 25 from it.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Riley Meredith

Commentary.Commentary: The ball needs to be changed now as Allen has hit it to the part of the ground from where it cannot be retrieved. Meanwhile, Aaron Finch and Dan Christian are having a word with the bowler.

SIX! 4th biggie in the over and just 11 needed now. Riley Meredith has been taken to the cleaners. This is the best one of the lot. Outside off, fuller. This is carved over the point fence for another maximum. Can Allen make it 5 in the over?

SIX! Make that three in four balls! Just the 17 needed in 8. Have to back the Windies from here. Meredith bowls a slower one but the length is short. Allen has enough time to pick it, he waits and then smashes it over the mid-wicket fence. Meredith under huge, huge pressure. He needs to bowl 2 good deliveries, needs to give Starc at least 14.

SIX! Allen clears the ropes now and two sixes from the first three balls! The game is well and truly still on. 23 needed in 9. This is a gift, a full toss on off, Allen does not miss out as he heaves it over the long on fence.
Good comeback! Goes full and just outside off, Russell looks to muscle it but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg for one.

SIX! There is one of them! 5 more needed! This is a tremendous shot. Also, that is one of the flatest sixes seen. A low full toss on middle, this is thumped down to the long on fence, it goes all the way. Riley under pressure now. Perfect start to the penultimate over for the Windies.
Riley Meredith to bowl the penultimate over. He has gone for 32 in his first three.

A dot to end so 11 from the over which is not bad by Starc keeping the context of the game in mind! A full toss outside off, Allen looks to go over mid off but misses. He may have sighted it late. It was a full toss and he would probably feel he missed out. 36 in 12 needed which means six sixes. Not a big deal for Russell right?
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! He even held the pose for the cameras! What a stroke! This is fuller and on off, Allen stands tall and lifts it elegantly over extra cover for another boundary.

FOUR! Off the outside edge and over short third man! This is frustrating for Starc! We have seen quite a few boundaries go in that area during his lowing. A low full toss outside off, Allen goes after it, it goes off the outside edge over short third man for another boundary.
How has that missed the stump? What a delivery. A pin-point yorker on off, Allen swings but misses. The ball lands and then moves away, goes just past the off pole.
A low full toss, not easy to hit those! This is hit towards long off who gets across to his right quickly and keeps it down to a single. Need boundaries, singles won't do it.

That is brilliant comeback from Carey! This is fuller and outside off, Russell swings, it goes off the outer half towards deep cover. The ball bounces and spins away a long way from Carey as he is deceived, it is going towards the ropes. Carey is wrong-footed but recovers well, dives and then saves two for his side.
Mitchell Starc is back on. He went for 20 in his first two.

No, just a single! This is short and on middle, Russell pulls it hard, it races away towards deep square leg for only one. 47 needed in 18 now. 10 from the over which means it is a good one for the Aussies.

SIX! Russell uses all of his muscle to clear the fence there! This is not a bad delivery, it is full and on middle, Russell stays deep in his crease and whips it well over the long on fence for a welcome biggie. Can he now get one more and end the over strongly?

Really well bowled! The game is now slipping away from the hosts! Another beautiful slower one, fuller and around off. Allen swings but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Dots are gold dust! A well-disguised slower one, fuller and outside off. Allen is early in the swing as he tries to hit it over mid-wicket but misses.
A crisp drive to begin! Just a single though, singles won't harm the Aussies! Full and outside off, it is driven through covers for one.
A low full toss on middle, it is hit down towards long on for one.
Jason Behrendorff is back on. He went for 14 in his two overs.
Just a single to end! This could well be the over which wins Australia the game! Just the 1 run and two wickets from it. 57 needed in the last 4. On off, this is guided towards point for one.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to covers.
No hat-trick but a dot! On middle, this is kept out.
Fabian Allen will face the hat trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Two-in-two and that is career best figures for Marsh! He is also on a hat-trick! Also, this is the wicket Australia needed. It is of the well set Simmons. Now Austraila well and truly on top. 58 needed in 27. This is shorter in length and it is angling into the body, Simmons is cramped for room but tries to pull. It goes more of the higher part this time, it is also against the wind. Moises Henriques at deep mid-wicket runs to his right and takes it. A good innings from Simmons but he needed to stay longer, especially after Pooran fell on the previous ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Moises Henriques b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Andre Russell walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! Marsh is the man for the Aussies. Both, with the ball and the bat. To be honest we here thought this is a gamble as he went for plenty in his last over but he gets the Windies skipper. Clever bowling, he keeps it full and wide outside off, making Pooran reach out for it. NP should have looked to go over the off side but instead tries to go downtown but since he was reaching out for it, it goes off the bottom. It goes towards long off where Christian is placed takes a good catch well inside the ropes.
Commentary.Howout: c Dan Christian b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! A dot, dots are what will build pressure! Another delivery which stays a touch low. Outside off, fractionally short. Pooran swings but misses.
Just a single as this is eased to long on. Just 20 runs and 2 wickets for Zampa in the spell!
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to deep point for one.
Darted down the leg side. Simmons gets hit on the pads while looking to flick it.
Hits it over the bowler's head and runs back for the second.
SIX! As long as Simmons is out there, West Indies remain in control! Comes down the track and sends it sailing over the long on fence.
Flatter ball, outside off. Cut away to point.
Change! Adam Zampa to bowl out. He went for 10 in his first 3 and took 2 wickets.
FOUR! 15 from the over and a good one for Windies! Full and wide outside off. Pooran just carves it to the point fence. 68 needed from the last 6.
Simmons comes down the track so Marsh follows him with a length ball. Eased down to long on for one.
Slips one down the leg side. Wide called.
Length ball, outside off. Pooran drags it off the inner half to the leg side for one.
SIX! Mighty blow! Back of a length, outside off. Pooran moves to the off side and hammers it over the wide long on fence.
Full and wide now. Pooran slaps it away towards the fence. But Moises Henriques runs to his left and dives to save two runs.
Short ball, outside off. Cut away to point.
Marsh is back on! He has been brilliant so far. It will be interesting to see if he does ball all of his 4 overs.

FOUR! Edged and a much-needed boundary for the hosts! Riley Meredith misses his length a touch and bowls a full one, wide outside off. Simmons gets the outside edge as he swings hard it. The ball runs to the third man fence.
He sees Simmons come down the track so fires a wide one. A bit too wide for the umpire's liking as he raises his arms now.
Brilliant execution by Riley Meredith! He nails the wide yorker and Simmons once again gets no bat on that.
Nails the yorker, on the pads. Simmons leaves it alone thinking that the umpire will call it a wide but the umpire is unmoved.
Another dot and that will increase the pressure! Wide yorker and Simmons fails to get any bat on it.
Slower length ball, on the pads. Pooran clips it to fine leg for one. The required run rate is touching 11.5 now!
Full and wide outside off. Simmons carves it to deep point for one.
Riley Meredith is back! 2-0-25-0 so far for him.
Fires a full one, on leg. Simmons backs away to the leg side and plays it to long off for one.
Swing and a miss! A slower one, down the leg side. Simmons looks to pull it by coming down the track but the ball goes under his bat.
Full ball, outside off. Pooran hits it to long off for a single.
Another slower one, this is full and on middle. Pooran defends it.
Slower length ball, outside off. Blocked out by Pooran. The dots will increase the pressure now.
Full toss, on the pads. Simmons clips it to deep square leg for one.
Jason Behrendorff is back! Went for 11 in his first but this is a good time for him to bowl. Can he grab a wicket for his side?
Yes, he does! Just the one run and a wicket from the over! Shorter ball, outside off. Pooran cuts it to point.
Flatter ball, on off. Blocked out. Can Zampa finish strong here?
Beaten! A nice googly, around off. Pooran is beaten as he looks to defend.
Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat now!

OUT! BOWLED! No need to go upstairs for that one as Adam Zampa ends Andre Fletcher's struggle! Flatter ball, on off. Fletcher looks to pull it away but the ball once again stays a bit low and sneaks under his bat. It goes and hits the off pole. 93 needed in 57 now!

NOT OUT! Loopy ball, around off. Fletcher looks to play it on the leg side but the ball stays low and hits in on the pads. Australia decides to review this one as the appeal is turned down but the impact is outside off.
A huge appeal for an LBW but turned down! Australia review. The impact seems outside off.
Tossed up, outside off. Simmons thumps it to sweeper cover for one.
Fletcher wanted two but just the one! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one. So 94 is what the Windies need in the last 10.
Somehow gets bat onto that one! This is short and on middle, this stays a little low. It is pulled through square leg for one.
Sees Flecther come down the track and drags his length back and also follows the batter. Fletcher defends it backt o the bowler.
Another dot! Fletcher is 5 from 10 balls. Outside off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Thumped! That is right in the slot for Fletcher! This is full and on middle, it is lofted over the bowler's head for a boundary. This should probably get him going now.
100 needed now! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Back-to-back good overs for the Aussies! On off, Fletcher pushes it to covers.
Another dot! On off, Fletcher guides it to point.
The googly, it lands on off and then turns back in! It is played back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, Fletcher is off the mark as he strokes it through covers.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Adam Zampa is back on. He went for 6 in his first over and also took a wicket.
He does so brilliantly and this is just the kind of over Australia needed! A run and a wicket from it. Another slower one on off, it is pushed to covers. 104 needed in 72.
Back of a length and on off, Fletcher plays it to point. This is a superb over so far, can he end it well?
Good length, slightly fuller, this is pushed back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! There is a huge inside edge! Even the Ultra Edge is not checked and hence, Fletcher reviewed it straightaway. This starts on off and then tails back in. Fletcher hangs back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Fletcher reviews it straightaway. Replays roll in and it shows a clear inside edge. He survives.
Review time! Andre Fletcher has reviewed this LBW decision. There is a big inside edge on that one, no need for Ultra Edge to confirm it.
Andre Fletcher walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! That is some take by Jason Behrendorff! Wow! Gayle does not last for long this time and Marsh comes on and strikes. He did it with the bat and now gets the big man. He bowls it full and wide outside off. Gayle looks to drag it over long on and hence, does not get the desired connection. It goes flat towards the fielder there who leaps, sticks both hands upwards and takes a stunner. Australia need to keep picking wickets if they are to win this game.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Behrendorff b Mitchell Marsh

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one to begin with! This one stays a touch low. It is worked through mid-wicket for one. Fifty for Simmons, he has been exceptional so far! Showed wide range of strokes but he needs to continue, still a long way to go.
Mitchell Marsh comes in the attack.
A single to end then! So 10 from this one, runs continue to flow after the Powerplay too. Another yorker outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
Yet another dot! Would have been a wide had he left it alone! A low full toss outside off, Simmons reaches out for it, it goes off the bottom edge towards the keeper.
A dot! Australia need a lot more of these! A yorker outside off, it is jammed out towards point.
FOUR! This is outstanding stuff from Simmons! Just brilliant! This is quite wide outside off. Simmons still manages to move there and scoop it over the square leg fielder for another boundary.

FOUR! That is not good bolwing! Especially with no fine leg. Simmons gets into position early to play the paddle scoop. Riley bowls a low full toss on the pads, it is worked fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Gayle is off the mark as he guides it down to third man for one.

FOUR! Zampa lets it through and the extra ball has cost Starc and Australia! 13 from the final over of the Powerplay and it has been West Indies who are cruising along. They are 75 for 1 and need only 115 now in 84. A yorker on off, Simmons looks to jam it out, it goes off the inside edge towards Zampa at short fine leg. He dives over it and it races away to the fence. Starc is not happy and rightly so.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, Simmons looks to flick but misses. Wided.
FOUR! Straight down the ground! This was right in the slot! Full and on middle, Simmons powers it down the ground for yet another boundary.
Pacey stuff! Goes short now and outside off, Simmons slashes but is beaten for pace. Quite risky that delivery with third man in the ring. Simmons just needed to connect.
Lovely from Starc! Bowls a yorker again and just outside off. Simmons fails to jam it out this time.
EDGY FOUR! West Indies won't care! This is full and on middle, Simmons looks to jam it out, it was a yorker actually. It goes off the outside edge past short third man for a boundary.
Driven nicely but for no runs! Fuller and on off, it is stroked nicely but to mid off.
Mitchell Starc is back on. He went for 7 in his first over.
Just 6 runs and a wicket from that over! Full ball, outside off. Gayle pushes it towards cover and a dive by the fielder stops the attempted run.

OUT! TIMBER! First wicket for Zampa in the series and what a time to get it! A quicker ball, on off. Lewis looks to cut it away by backing away to the leg side but gets no bat on it. The ball clips the off pole and the Aussies get their first wicket!
Chris Gayle walks out to bat.
Loopy ball, on off. Simmons hits it towards long on, on the bounce though.
Quicker ball, on the pads. Lewis clips it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! Different bowler, same result! Tossed up, on middle. Lewis hits it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Lewis fails to get any bat on it.
Adam Zampa comes in the attack now!
23 from that over! Full ball, on off. Lewis hits it down to long on for one.
SIX! 50 up in no time and they seem to be in a hurry to finish things off! Dan Christian bowls a short one, on off. Evin Lewis pulls it over the fine leg fence now.
SIX! Tonked! Length ball, outside off. Lewis says thank you very much and hits it straight down the ground for a maximum.
Full and wide now. Wide called. But the plan now seems to be to stay way outside the arc of Lewis.
Has to reload as he sprays this one wide outside off.
FOUR! Just over the fielder! Short and wide again. Lewis hits it just over the leaping mid on fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! First boundary for Lewis! Short ball, outside off. Lewis pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball has enough legs to trickle to the fence.
Slower length ball, outside off. Lewis carves it towards backward point.
Dan Christian comes in the attack now.
FOUR! Almost takes out the umpire with that shot! Lendl Simmons comes down the track and hammers it down the ground. The umpire moves to his left just in time and allows the ball to run to the fence.
Slower length ball, on middle. Lewis clips it towards short fine leg for one.
Fires a length ball, on the pads. Lewis gets hit on the pads as he misses his pull.
FOUR! Just over! A slower full toss, outside off. Lewis hits it just over the man at mid off for a boundary.
Slower length ball, on the pads. Simmons chips it towards deep mid-wicket for one. No ball called as Jason Behrendorff has overstepped.
Back of a length, on middle. Simmons flat bats it to the stumps at the other end.
Length ball, on off. Simmons gets hit high on the pads as he looks to flick it. Matthew Wade dives forward to take it. Jason Behrendorff appeals, presumably for the LBW but it is turned down.
Jason Behrendorff comes in the attack now.
Back of a length, around off. Punched to covers. 15 from the over!
Slower length ball, on off. Simmons clips it to leg side and asks Lewis to play his first ball.
FOUR! Powered away and Riley Meredith is under pressure! Back of a length, on off. Simmons pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Expensive start by Riley Meredith! Slower length ball, on the pads. Simmons swipes it to the square leg fence.
SIX! Thumped! A length ball, in the slot. Simmons clears his front leg and hits it over the mid-wicket fence.
Length ball, on the pads. Simmons whips it away but Zampa does well at short fine leg to save a boundary.
Riley Meredith to start from the other end.
Back of a length, on the pads. Clipped to the leg side for one. 7 from the first over!
Low full toss, outside off. Simmons punches it to covers but a midfield allows them to take a couple before the fielder chases it down.
FOUR! Lendl Simmons and West Indies are underway with a boundary! Length ball, outside off. Simmons clears his front leg and hits it over mid off. The ball runs to the fence.
Full ball, on off and swinging back in a touch. Simmons pushes it back to Starc.
Back of a length, outside off. Pushed to covers.
Some swing! Full ball, lands on middle and nips back in. Simmons is hit on the pads as he looks to flick. A subdued appeal as the ball was heading down the leg side.
